data.name: 操作紀錄保存
data.value: Audit record retention

data.name: 管理操作紀錄、告警、通知與安全變更歷史的保存期限。
data.value: Manage retention for audit records, alerts, notifications and security change history.

data.name: 此期限適用於中央設定、設備、Agent、安全設定、事件查詢與匯出、背景工作、帳號與 API 憑證的操作紀錄，以及告警、通知、已結束的背景工作、YARA 掃描結果（含規則與輸出）、盤點與檔案完整性變更歷史、漏洞評估歷史與安全基準觀測歷史。目前的盤點快照、完整性狀態、漏洞評估及各基準版本最新觀測會保留。GitHub Advisory 不再使用的舊版本及已完成或放棄的匯入暫存也依期限清理；目前及前一可用版本、共享來源與已發布的撤回紀錄會保留。其他安全事件證據不在此期限內。首次管理員初始化紀錄、進行中的告警、尚未排入派送的通知與未結束的工作會保留。到期後定期清理，延長期限無法還原已刪除資料。
data.value: This period covers audit records for platform settings, devices, Agent, security settings, event queries and exports, background jobs, accounts and API credentials; alerts, notifications, completed jobs, YARA scan results (including rules and output), inventory and file integrity change history, vulnerability assessment history and security baseline observation history. Current inventory snapshots, integrity states, vulnerability assessments and latest observations per baseline version are retained. Unused older GitHub Advisory versions and completed or abandoned import staging are cleaned under this period; current and previous usable versions, shared sources and published withdrawals are retained. Other security evidence is outside this period. Initial administrator setup records, ongoing alerts, notifications not yet queued for delivery and unfinished jobs are retained. Expired data is cleaned periodically; extending retention cannot restore deleted data.

data.name: SigmaHQ、Signature-Base、CISA KEV、FIRST EPSS 與 Debian 的舊情報內容也依此期限清理；目前使用、上一個可用、最新候選及仍被事件引用的版本會保留。版本及啟用紀錄仍可查詢；已清理內容的舊版本無法直接回復。
data.value: Older SigmaHQ, Signature-Base, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS and Debian intelligence content is also cleaned under this period. The current, previous usable, latest candidate and event-referenced versions are retained. Version and activation records remain queryable; older versions with deleted content cannot be restored directly.

data.name: Ubuntu 與 Microsoft 安全情報的舊封存檔與不再使用的內容也依此期限清理；仍被其他版本使用的共用文件，以及已發布的撤回資訊會保留。
data.value: Older Ubuntu and Microsoft security intelligence archives and unused content are also cleaned under this period; shared files still used by other versions and published withdrawals are retained.

data.name: 此期限也適用於已停止重試的 Hangfire 失敗工作；執行中及等待重試的工作會保留。
data.value: This period also applies to failed Hangfire jobs that have stopped retrying; running jobs and those awaiting retry are retained.
